timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, I'm Sanjay Puri. I'm the principal architect of Sanjay Puri Architects.
Our head office is Mumbai in India, but you're doing work all over.
I got this invite from the leaders in design Meena and I think it's a good thing always to meet architects and designers from different parts of the world.
Because there's a lot of interaction, you get to know what's happening, where it's happening and how it's happening.
I think there are a lot of business opportunities here.
And there's a lot of work that's happening here constantly, but most of it is all too commercialized.
And I feel that the whole Middle East region needs buildings that look like they belong here.
And most of the ones that are constructed now don't look like that.
This was sharing of thoughts and ideas because otherwise you're sitting in your own bubble in your own place and designing the way you are.
But whenever you meet people from across the world from different parts, you get to see different kinds of design solutions and these are very important to learn from.
We are currently doing everything from large residential townships to large residential projects, office buildings, hotels, institutional projects.
Well, the experience is good because you're meeting a lot of different people and you're getting to see a lot of different work.

youtube_description:
Sanjay Puri, Founder of Sanjay Puri Architects, attended as one of the speakers at Leaders in Design MENA summit happened on the 15th and 16th of November 2015 held at Ritz-Carlton JBR, Dubai, UAE.

Leaders in Design MENA is key meeting place for interior design professionals from the region to discuss the latest global markets trends in the industry as well as learn and source 360° solutions for their diverse portfolios of projects.
